sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive leadership dominates the tape as Healthcare and Consumer Defensive show sustained, multi-timeframe strength while cyclical and growth sectors anchor the bottom.

Defensive sectors are firmly in control, evidenced by Healthcare and Consumer Defensive standing as the only groups positive across all tracked timeframes. Energy maintains the top year-to-date position, supported by solid momentum, while Financials and Basic Materials sit in the middle tier. 

Relative performance across sectors remains static over the past five sessions, with zero net rank changes across the board. Growth and cyclicals continue to fade or lag, highlighted by severe momentum deficits in Communication Services and Industrials.

## Strength
- **Narrow All-Green Breadth:** Only 2 of 11 sectors—Healthcare (momentum 0.90) and Consumer Defensive (momentum 0.87)—are positive across the week, month, quarter, half-year, and YTD timeframes.
- **Sustained Leadership:** Healthcare and Consumer Defensive are the sole groups holding top-3 rank consistency across 1-, 3-, and 6-month periods.
- **Top YTD Performance:** Energy holds the #1 YTD rank with strong 0.750 momentum, trailing only Healthcare and Consumer Defensive in overall strength.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Static Short-Term Rotation:** Zero sectors registered rank changes over the last 5 sessions (+0 spots across all tracked groups), reflecting frozen leadership hierarchies.
- **Momentum Leaders:** Healthcare (0.900, YTD rank 4), Consumer Defensive (0.867, YTD rank 3), and Energy (0.750, YTD rank 1) lead the market in overall velocity.
- **Severe Momentum Fades:** Communication Services sits at absolute zero momentum (0.000, YTD rank 11), followed closely by Industrials (0.283, YTD rank 6) and Consumer Cyclical (0.383, YTD rank 10).

## Divergences
- **Technology Momentum Breakdown:** Technology holds the #2 YTD rank, yet its momentum score has deteriorated to a lagging 0.400.
- **Financials Outpacing Tech:** Financials sit down at YTD rank 8 but exhibit stronger underlying momentum (0.533) than higher-ranking peers like Technology (0.400) and Basic Materials (0.483).

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Cyclical consumer goods and travel-related groups are surging to the top, while software, internet, and select defensives experience sharp short-term distribution.

Market breadth shows 28 of 144 groups maintaining all-green status across all timeframes. Leaders are anchored by Textile Manufacturing (momentum 0.91), Drug Manufacturers - General (momentum 0.89), and hospitality pockets like Lodging (momentum 0.88) and REIT - Hotel & Motel (momentum 0.86), all demonstrating durable multi-month strength.

Concurrently, capital is rotating aggressively into housing and consumer discretionary laggards, with Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances (+22 spots) and Residential Construction (+18 spots) posting major weekly rank gains. Conversely, technology infrastructure and digital services are fading rapidly, led by steep multi-session drops in Software - Infrastructure (-32 spots) and Internet Content & Information (-28 spots).

## Strength
- **Broad Market Breadth:** 28 of 144 industry groups are positive across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD periods.
- **Top Momentum Anchors:** Textile Manufacturing leads all groups with a 0.909 momentum score (YTD rank 12), closely followed by Drug Manufacturers - General at 0.894 (YTD rank 25) and Lodging at 0.880 (YTD rank 22).
- **Sustained Leadership:** Groups sustaining top-36 ranks across the 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons include REIT - Hotel & Motel (momentum 0.855), Tobacco (momentum 0.830), Beverages - Non-Alcoholic, and Health Information Services.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Surging Consumer & Construction:** Textile Manufacturing jumped +26 spots to rank 12, Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances advanced +22 spots to rank 44 (momentum 0.82), and Auto & Truck Dealerships gained +19 spots to rank 106.
- **Sharp Pullbacks:** Software - Infrastructure tumbled -32 spots to rank 78 (momentum 0.40), while Internet Content & Information plunged -28 spots to rank 120 with an anemic 0.100 momentum score.
- **Bottom Laggards:** Uranium (momentum 0.035, YTD rank 136) and Advertising Agencies (momentum 0.037, YTD rank 144) sit at the bottom of relative momentum rankings alongside Education & Training Services (momentum 0.127).

## Divergences
- **Fading High-Momentum Groups:** Short-term rank deterioration is emerging in Diagnostics & Research (momentum 0.71, down -12 spots in 5 sessions) and Department Stores (momentum 0.62, down -13 spots in 5 sessions).
- **Emerging Bottom Turnarounds:** Early rank improvements without high momentum confirmation include Luxury Goods (rank improved +19 spots, momentum 0.47) and Engineering & Construction (rank improved +16 spots, momentum 0.36).
